title: Cyber Snake
description: Guide your glowing serpent across the grid, consume energy nodes, and avoid crashing into walls or yourself.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD to navigate.
Eat green energy orbs for 10 points and rare gold nodes for 50 points.
Speed increases as your length grows.
Don't collide with the borders or your own tail.

title: Galaxy Defender
description: Defend humanity against descending waves of alien invaders in this arcade space shooter.
instructions: Move left and right to evade incoming enemy laser ordnance.
Press Spacebar to fire your ship's laser cannons.
Eliminate all alien invaders to advance to the next wave.
You have 3 shields before the ship is destroyed.

title: Astro Flap
description: Fire thrusters to maneuver your cosmonaut through hazardous orbital plasma gates.
instructions: Click or press Spacebar to activate upward micro-thrusters.
Navigate safely through the gaps between plasma pillars.
Earn Bronze medal at 10, Silver at 25, and Gold at 50 points.

title: Neon Pong 2P
description: High-speed cybernetic table tennis. Play solo against the AI or challenge a friend locally.
instructions: Choose Solo vs Computer or 2-Player local face-off.
Deflect the ball at an angle to add speed and curve.
First player to score 7 points wins the match.

title: Block Matrix
description: The classic falling polyomino puzzle. Position, rotate, and drop blocks to clear complete rows.
instructions: Fit falling geometric blocks together to fill complete horizontal lines.
Clearing 4 lines at once awards a massive Tetris bonus.
Use C to hold a piece for later when you need it most.

title: Breakout Blaster
description: Demolish barriers of colored bricks with your paddle and ball, collecting powerups as they fall.
instructions: Keep the ball in play by deflecting it off your paddle.
Break all bricks to advance to higher stages.
Catch falling powerups: Wide Paddle (W), Multiball (M), and Extra Life (+).

title: 2048 Neon
description: Slide numbered tiles across the board and merge pairs of matching numbers to reach 2048.
instructions: Slide all tiles on the board simultaneously in four directions.
Tiles with the same number merge into one when they collide.
Build up to the legendary 2048 tile to win!

title: T-Rex Horizon
description: Sprint endlessly through the desert canyon, leaping over cacti and ducking under pterodactyls.
instructions: Jump over low and tall cacti.
Duck under flying pterodactyls.
Speed accelerates as your run distance increases.

title: Minesweeper Pro
description: Clear the explosive minefield using numbered clues and logical deduction.
instructions: Click tiles to reveal them without hitting a mine.
Numbers show how many adjacent mines are hidden nearby.
Right-click or toggle flag mode to mark suspected mines.

title: Connect 4 Tactics
description: Drop colored tokens into the grid. Connect 4 in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line to win.
instructions: Click any column or press 1-7 to drop your disc.
Play against AI or face off with a friend locally.
Connect 4 consecutive discs of your color to claim victory.
